# Programming Language

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ProgrammingLanguage`](gmeow-ProgrammingLanguage.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ProgrammingLanguage>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/language`](../../slices/language.md)

A formal language for expressing executable computation (Python, Rust, SQL-as-implemented). The first-class target of [`gmeow:writtenInLanguage`](../properties/gmeow-writtenInLanguage.md), by which a software project declares the languages it is written in.
